key_points: 16 major issuers including Microsoft, Alphabet, Goldman Sachs, Broadcom, Verizon object to OKX-ICE tokenized stock platform, limiting potential supply
Objections signal issuer reluctance toward tokenized equity trading, threatening a strategic growth initiative for ICE
NYSE (ICE subsidiary) expands options trading hours for major names like Apple and Microsoft, a modest core-business positive
Insider selling and analyst price-target updates are routine noise
Net effect: slightly negative on a peripheral venture, not thesis-changing for core exchange/clearing/data franchise
